upstream_expectation: the JSON-LD 1.0 compaction of "Index map round-tripping" (option.specVersion=json-ld-1.0), in which every term — expanded-form term definitions included — is a compact-IRI prefix candidate, producing the body:/format-style prefix-compacted keys 0038-out.jsonld pins
our_expectation: the JSON-LD 1.1 compaction, which under processingMode=json-ld-1.0 does NOT use an expanded term definition as a compact-IRI prefix — the behavior this suite's OWN #tp001 ("Compact IRI will not use an expanded term definition in 1.0") explicitly pins
rationale: t0038's json-ld-1.0 expected output directly contradicts the same suite's 1.1 conformance pin #tp001. One processingMode-driven engine state cannot satisfy both: t0038 wants expanded-form terms treated as prefix candidates in 1.0 processing mode; tp001 pins the opposite for the 1.1 API running in 1.0 processing mode. This program implements the JSON-LD 1.1 API, so tp001 (the in-suite 1.1 conformance pin) wins and t0038's only remaining divergence — body:/format-style prefix compaction — is excluded by design. Diagnosed 2026-07-16: t0038's sole diff vs this engine is that prefix compaction (confirmed with -v). See JSONLD.Compact.fst's cmp_curie_loop comment for why the gate is not relaxed under ac_mode10. Previously carried as a per-ID skip in jsonld_compact_runner.ml; converted to a local-override on 2026-07-17 so the test runs and its disagreement is counted distinctly rather than hidden.
owner_directive: if we carefully disagree with test make our own local override of it. Shex Also. (owner, 2026-07-17)
